blocks.text: Chemical karkhanon (industrial chemical facilities) mein hadsaat rokne aur karkunon (workers) aur mahol ki hifazat ke liye sakht safety measures zaroori hain. In mein yeh shamil hain:

items: Karkun personal protective equipment (PPE, zaati hifazat ka saman) jaise dastane (gloves), goggles (hifazati chashme), helmets, lab coats aur hifazati joote pehnein, taake chemicals, garmi ya nuqsan deh dhuen (fumes) se chot na lage.

Chemicals par sahi label lage hon, aur unhein un ki khasiyaton (properties) ke mutabiq sambhala aur rakha jaye. Jaldi aag pakarne wale (flammable), zehreele (toxic) ya cheezon ko gala dene wale (corrosive) chemicals munasib dabbon (containers) aur alag godamon mein rakhe jayein, taake rasaao (leaks), girna (spills), milawat (contamination) ya khatarnak reactions na hon.

Industries ke paas aag, chemicals girne, gas ke rasaao ya dhamakon se nimatne ke wazeh emergency plans hon. Emergency exits (hangami darwaze), aag bujhane ke aalaat (fire extinguishers), first-aid kits aur gire hue chemicals sambhalne ka saman maujood ho, aur karkun jaante hon ke emergency mein kya karna hai.

Kaam ki jagah se zehreeli gases, dhuan aur gard nikaalne ke liye achha ventilation system (hawa ke guzar ka nizam) zaroori hai. Hawa ka sahi bahao nuqsan deh cheezein saans mein jaane ka khatra kam karta hai aur kaam ka mahol mehfooz aur sehatmand rakhta hai.

Karkunon ko khatarnak cheezein sambhalne aur machines chalane ki sahi safety training milni chahiye. Machines, pipelines aur storage tanks ki ba-qaida jaanch (inspection) aur dekh bhaal (maintenance) se kharabiyan jaldi pakri jaati hain aur hadsaat ka khatra kam hota hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Pakistan ki maeeshat ke (zaraat ke ilawa) do bare shobe batayein jo chemical industry par bohat munhasir hain, aur har aik ke liye aik zaroori chemical product batayein.
blocks.explanation: Textiles (kapra): caustic soda (saath mein synthetic dyes aur hydrogen peroxide). Construction (tameerat): cement.

blocks.prompt: b) Crude oil ko alag karne wale process ka physical usool (intermolecular forces aur boiling points ke lihaz se) samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Fractional distillation hydrocarbons ko boiling point ke farq se alag karti hai. Bare molecules mein intermolecular (London dispersion) forces zyada taqatwar hoti hain, is liye un ke boiling points zyada hote hain aur woh column mein neeche hi condense ho jaate hain; chhote molecules oopar ja kar condense hote hain.

blocks.prompt: c) Bohat se cosmetics aur perfumes mein esters hote hain. Ester banane ke liye do qisam ke reactants aur aam catalyst batayein.
blocks.explanation: Carboxylic acid aur alcohol; aam catalyst garha (concentrated) sulphuric acid hai.

blocks.prompt: d) Samjhayein ke garhe HNO₃ jaise tez oxidizing chemicals ko ethanol jaise jaldi aag pakarne wale organic chemicals se alag kyun rakha jaye.
blocks.explanation: Oxidizing agent aag pakarne wale organic compound se tez aur bohat exothermic redox reaction kar sakta hai; dono mil jayein (maslan gir jaane par) to aag ya dhamaka ho sakta hai.

items: Safety: PPE pehnna; sahi label aur alag storage; emergency plans; achha ventilation; training aur maintenance.
